claims.quote: group-level comparisons revealed attenuated visual evoked potentials (VEPs) in participants with Rett syndrome (n = 43) and CDKL5 deficiency disorder (n = 16) compared to typically-developing participants.

claims.object_text: AEP amplitude correlated with clinical severity
claims.quote: AEP amplitude correlated with severity in Rett syndrome and CDKL5 deficiency disorder.

claims.object_text: AEP latency correlated with clinical severity
claims.quote: AEP latency correlated with severity in CDKL5 deficiency disorder, MECP2 duplication syndrome, and FOXG1 syndrome.

claims.object_text: feasibility of evoked potentials to track disease severity
claims.quote: We have previously demonstrated the feasibility and tracking of evoked potentials to disease severity in Rett syndrome and CDKL5 deficiency disorder.
